channel.title: API Changelog
channel.description: Stay updated with API changes and version history

item.title: API key signing algorithm metadata
item.description: GET /api_keys includes key_type for RSA and Ed25519 keys.
item.content:encoded: GET /api_keys now includes key_type (rsa or ed25519) on each supported key, including keys created before this change. The field is omitted when the algorithm is unknown.

item.title: MCP portfolio access for perps
item.description: read::mcp_portfolio OAuth grants can read margin balances, positions, orders, fills and risk.
item.content:encoded: Registered MCP clients can read margin balances, positions, orders, fills and risk (GET /margin/balance, /margin/positions, /margin/orders, /margin/fills, /margin/risk) using explicitly granted read::mcp_portfolio OAuth access. GET /margin/risk includes leverage and estimated liquidation prices. Existing grants of this scope include this access. These grants do not allow order execution or funding changes. GET /margin/markets, /margin/markets/{ticker} and /margin/markets/{ticker}/orderbook accept a resource-bound MCP grant for per-user rate accounting; their anonymous payloads remain unchanged.

item.title: MCP access to settlements
item.description: read::mcp_portfolio OAuth grants can read GET /portfolio/settlements.
item.content:encoded: Registered MCP clients can read settlements (GET /portfolio/settlements) using explicitly granted read::mcp_portfolio OAuth access. Existing grants of this scope include this access. Archived settlements remain outside this endpoint.

item.title: market_lifecycle_v2 covers trading-hours closes
item.description: Margin market_lifecycle_v2 sends deactivated when a market's trading hours end and activated when they begin.
item.content:encoded: The margin market_lifecycle_v2 channel now also sends deactivated when a market's trading hours end and activated when they begin. is_deactivated is true while the market is halted or outside its trading hours.

item.title: Minimum order quantity in /margin/markets
item.description: Margin market responses now include minimum_quantity, the minimum order quantity in contracts.
item.content:encoded: Margin market responses now include minimum_quantity, the minimum order quantity in contracts.
